item.title: Re: SCP-3790-J: -1
item.content:encoded: People have different senses of humor? Like, no need to be so hung up on the fact you didn't find an article funny. It's totally valid to not find the article funny but no need to question everyone else who enjoyed it. It's just a joke. Let people laugh.

item.title: Re: SCP-3790-J: -1
item.content:encoded:
This may come as a great shock to you, but humor is incredibly subjective. Stories have mostly uniform structure but the comedy in what you find funny differs wildly from person to person. What you found funny will likely not hit for someone else, and vice versa. Hell, you acknowledge that these are "just your tastes", which don't apply to everyone.

I have no qualms with someone disliking the work, I think its fine if some jokes don't land with some people, but I think it's silly to pretend we don't understand that other people can find stuff we don't find funny to be…. well, funny.

item.title: SCP-3790-J: -1
item.content:encoded:
I didn't even crack a small smile, and I chuckle at least once at basically every Joke SCP, even if I hate it, but this really has nothing going to it. Parodying the Department of Abnormalities could definitely work, but this article fails to achieve that in any way approaching my tastes in humor, but those are just my tastes. Maybe I'm not getting some extremely funny hidden punchline or something similar, but I am extremely confused as to how a joke SCP like this is already at more than 50 upvotes.

Seriously, did I somehow miss the main punchline here? The only "end-whammer" I see is the back half of Josie, which has been found at least four times already.

EDIT: Please do not misconstrue this comment as intentionally mean-spirited. I'm just trying to say I'm a bit confused by this article's seemingly random super-great reception and upvote count because I see very few good jokes within.
